queries_attempted: employee time off tracking software for small business
automated PTO request and approval system
excel alternative for managing employee leave balances
google sheets PTO template with accruals
simple leave management app for startups
payroll integrated time off tracking small business

competitors.name: BambooHR
competitors.notes: Full‑featured HRIS with built‑in time‑off tracking, accruals, and approval workflows. Used by many SMBs. May be over‑kill for a single HR person just needing leave, but it directly solves the JTBD.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated workflows, custom accrual policies, employee self‑service, calendar, payroll sync (via integration).
competitors.pricing: Starts ~$6‑8/employee/month; often requires core HR platform.

competitors.name: Gusto
competitors.notes: Payroll‑first platform with built‑in PTO tracking that syncs automatically with payroll. Common choice for small businesses already using Gusto for payroll.
competitors.feature_overlap: PTO requests, accrual automation, direct payroll sync, employee self‑service.
competitors.pricing: Base plan starts at $40/month + $6/person. Time‑off included in Plus plan.
competitors.market_positioning: Integrated payroll, benefits, and HR for small businesses.

competitors.name: LeaveBoard (by Remote)
competitors.notes: Pure‑play leave management SaaS. Designed for small to mid‑size teams, with emphasis on simplicity. Strong accrual policy engine and multi‑currency support.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated accruals, calendar integrations, approval flows, reports. Syncs with Google Calendar and Slack.
competitors.pricing: Free for up to 10 employees, then ~$1.5/user/month.
competitors.market_positioning: Simple, affordable leave management for modern teams.

competitors.name: Vacation Tracker
competitors.notes: Lightweight PTO tracking tool with Slack & Teams integration. Targets small teams that want a shared‑spreadsheet replacement. Built‑in accruals and approvals.
competitors.feature_overlap: Unlimited accrual policies, custom rules, team calendar, Slack/Teams/Email integrations, reports.
competitors.pricing: From $1/user/month (billed annually); free for up to 10 users with limited features.
competitors.market_positioning: Simple, team‑friendly leave tracking for remote and hybrid teams.

competitors.name: Calamari
competitors.notes: Dedicated leave and attendance management. Strong in custom accrual configurations. Integrates with HR/payroll tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira).
competitors.feature_overlap: Configurable accrual rules, multiple leave types, approval workflows, calendar, mobile app, payroll/HR integrations.
competitors.market_positioning: Flexible leave management for SMBs with complex policies.

competitors.name: Absence.io
competitors.notes: European‑focused leave management with strong compliance features. Handles complex local accrual rules (e.g., German sick leave). Suitable for multi‑country teams.
competitors.feature_overlap: Custom accrual policies, multi‑step approvals, absence types, team calendar, payroll export, REST API.
competitors.pricing: Starts at €1.5/user/month; free for up to 10 users.
competitors.market_positioning: Compliance‑driven absence management for global SMBs.

competitors.name: PTO by Roots
competitors.notes: Slack‑first PTO tracker (now integrated with Roots family). Very simple, ideal for Slack‑centric teams. Accruals and custom rules available.
competitors.feature_overlap: PTO requests in Slack, accrual tracking, shared calendar, reporting, integrations with GCal.
competitors.market_positioning: Slack‑native PTO tracker for modern teams.

competitors.name: Zoho People
competitors.notes: HR suite with a leave management module. Suitable for existing Zoho ecosystem users. Full‑featured but may be over‑complex for a solo HR person.
competitors.feature_overlap: Configurable leave policies, accrual automation, employee/manager self‑service, payroll integrations, mobile app.
competitors.pricing: Starter plan ~$1.25/user/month; leave management is a module within broader HRMS.
competitors.market_positioning: Integrated HR platform for SMBs, especially in Zoho ecosystem.

competitors.name: OrangeHRM Open Source
competitors.notes: Open‑source HR management system with a time‑off module. Can be self‑hosted for free, but requires technical setup. Limited out‑of‑box usability for a solo HR person.
competitors.feature_overlap: Leave application, approval, accrual tracking, calendar, reports, payroll integration possible via API.
competitors.pricing: Free open‑source edition; paid cloud plans start ~$5/user/month.
competitors.market_positioning: Affordable, customizable HR suite for tech‑savvy SMBs.

competitors.name: AttendBot (on Slack/Teams)
competitors.notes: Bot‑based time‑off and attendance tracking inside Slack/Teams. Replaces email and spreadsheet for small teams. Offers accruals and approvals.
competitors.feature_overlap: PTO requests, accrual engine, team calendar, multi‑step approvals, payroll export (CSV), integrates with Office 365.
competitors.pricing: Free for up to 25 users; Pro at ~$1/user/month.
competitors.market_positioning: Communication‑platform‑native leave management for Slack/Teams users.

competitors.name: Excel/Google Sheets PTO templates (e.g., Smartsheet, Vertex42)
competitors.notes: Free or low‑cost template with accrual formulas. Direct substitute for the current workflow, but still requires manual data entry and reconciliation, lacking automation.
competitors.feature_overlap: Manual balance tracking, basic accrual calculations, no request workflow or payroll sync.
competitors.market_positioning: DIY spreadsheet solution for very small teams.

competitors.name: HR consultants / service providers (e.g., Bambee, fractional HR)
competitors.notes: Service‑based offering where HR experts manage leave policies and tracking for a monthly retainer. Not a software, but solves the same pain for the target user who prefers to outsource.
competitors.feature_overlap: Managed leave administration, compliance, payroll reconciliation done by experts.

substitutes.name: Google Sheets / Excel manual tracker
substitutes.description: Hand‑built spreadsheet with formulas, as currently used.
substitutes.notes: Zero cost, familiar, but error‑prone and lacks automation.

substitutes.name: Email/chat request threads + manual update
substitutes.description: Requests via email/Slack, HR updates a master calendar manually.
substitutes.notes: Low cost, but scales poorly, leads to disputes.

substitutes.name: Calendly / scheduling tools (misuse)
substitutes.description: Using Calendly to book “out‑of‑office” events, manually tracking in calendar.
substitutes.notes: Not a leave management tool; no accruals, conflicts, or payroll sync.

summary: The competitive landscape for employee time‑off and leave management is crowded, with many well‑established SaaS products targeting small businesses and HR‑of‑one scenarios. Direct competitors like LeaveBoard, Vacation Tracker, Calamari, and Absence.io offer simple, affordable solutions that directly replace the spreadsheet‑and‑email workflow. Full‑platform plays (BambooHR, Gusto, Zoho People) embed leave tracking as part of broader HR/payroll, often already adopted by the target audience. Platform‑native bot‑based tools (PTO by Roots, AttendBot) lower the barrier further. Open‑source and template substitutes exist, though they lack automation. Pricing for purpose‑built tools starts at $1–$3/user/month, with free tiers for tiny teams, making the switching cost very low. Given the abundance of credible, feature‑complete alternatives, the market is not a greenfield. Nevertheless, most products tie accrual calculations to simple policies; there might still be room for hyper‑simple spreadsheet replacement with dead‑simple payroll sync for non‑tech HR users, but any new entrant would face fierce competition from incumbents with strong brand and integration moats. Based on this evidence, the opportunity falls into a crowded market.
